## Testing Checklist
- [ ] Tested on **Classic Borland Turbo Mode** (verified styling, menus, and shortcuts).
- [ ] Tested on **Modern Dark / Modern Light Mode**.
- [ ] Compiled and ran a **C program** (tested with GCC).
- [ ] Compiled and ran a **C++ program** (tested with G++).
- [ ] Verified that **compiler errors** parse correctly and jump to the editor line upon click.
- [ ] Verified that **standard input (STDIN)** works for interactive programs.
- [ ] Tested process termination / timeout limits (programs terminate within timeout ceiling).
- [ ] Executed `npm run lint` and `npm run build` with zero errors.
